description: This file defines the interface for IMediaKeysCapabilities and its factory within the Rialto project, used for querying EME decryption capabilities and supported key systems.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for obtaining the singleton instance of IMediaKeysCapabilities.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Interface for querying supported EME key systems and their versions.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory singleton.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system strings.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
